title: Registered email address: user receives a reset link by email
expected_output: A confirmation message is shown and the user receives a reset link by email

title: Email address without an @ sign is rejected
steps: Enter "userexample.com" in the email address field
expected_output: The email address is rejected, a validation error is shown next to the field, and the user does not receive a reset link by email

title: New password with 7 characters is rejected
steps: Enter "Passw0r" (7 characters) in the new password field
expected_output: The new password is rejected, the form is not submitted and an error message explains the limit (at least 8 characters)
